build_Gemma3nTransformer: build a Gemma3nTransformer model instance with a TransformerConfig for multimodal text and image inference
run_Gemma3nTransformer_call: run the Gemma3nTransformer forward pass with token inputs and optional images to get logits and cache
init_Gemma3nTransformer_cache: initialize a KV cache for the Gemma3nTransformer with a given batch size dtype and cache length
review_Gemma3nTransformer_encode_and_get: review the Gemma3nTransformer _encode_and_get_inputs method that encodes text tokens and merges vision embeddings
summarize_Output: summarize the Gemma3nTransformer Output dataclass containing logits cache and optional hidden states
